parameters.content:
## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #04 BLUEPRINT
### n8n vs Zapier vs Make Pricing (2027): Replace $149/mo With $6.49

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep04&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Order_ID | Client_Name | Client_Email | Deal_Amount | Priority_Tier | Zapier_Fee_Saved`
* [Open Episode #04 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep04/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NO6nRD4wC7c)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Captures real incoming Webhooks from Stripe, Shopify, Typeform, or Calendly (replaces Zapier Webhook Pro).
* **Zone 2:** Dynamically normalizes customer fields, calculates deal tier, and routes VIP deals (`>= $1,000`) without paying per-step Zapier fees.
* **Zone 3:** Logs enriched leads/orders to Google Sheets CRM & sends instant VIP Gmail notifications.

---
*📂 Need more free templates? Visit [360rev-hub.github.io](https://360rev-hub.github.io/?src=json_footer)*

## STEP 1: Universal Webhook Trigger (Zero Task Fees)
1. **1. Incoming Lead / Order Webhook** gives you a dedicated HTTPS Webhook URL on your [Hostinger KVM 1 n8n Cloud](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep04&src=json_step1).
2. Paste this URL into Stripe, Shopify, Webflow, Elementor, or Typeform!

## STEP 2: Multi-Step Lead Normalizer & VIP Router
1. **2. Normalize & Enrich Payload** parses real webhook fields (`body.email`, `body.name`, `body.amount`) and formats currency.
2. **3. Is VIP Deal (>= $1,000)?** routes high-ticket orders for priority handling (in Zapier, every filter & path costs extra tasks; in n8n it is 100% free!).

## STEP 3: Sync to Master CRM Sheet & VIP Alert
1. Double-click **4. Sync to Master CRM Google Sheet** -> select your CRM spreadsheet.
2. Optional: Connect **5. Send VIP Deal Alert (Gmail)** for deals over $1,000.
